name: Pastrana (Spain)
description: Vertically divided white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pastrana (the letter P and a skull on blue, and a cross and keys on white).
history: Municipal flag of Pastrana; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Pastrana arms — letter P and skull on blue, cross and keys on white
letter P, keys and crown of the arms
